d: Severe Cyclone Arnab has made landfall along India's eastern coast in Andhra Pradesh, bringing roaring wind gusts of up to 150 km/h and torrential rainfall exceeding 200 mm. At least five fatalities have been reported, with thousands of homes damaged and major disruptions to flights and train operations. Authorities evacuated over 180,000 people across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha into multi-purpose shelters, but the financial and human toll remains devastating.
